score_rationale: The candidate demonstrates sufficient backend engineering experience and familiarity with AWS, but lacks the direct leadership experience and full-stack technical skills required for the Engineering Manager role.
key_strengths: Solid backend engineering experience, AWS certification, understanding of service reliability and team collaboration, and evidence of communication skills.
key_weaknesses: Inadequate evidence of line management experience (less than 2 years), no experience leading teams through significant technical change, and lack of direct experience with React/TypeScript and Node.js/.NET.
final_evaluation: MegaMarcus has strong technical foundations in backend systems and cloud infrastructure, but lacks the essential leadership and full-stack experience needed to effectively manage the Web Development team and lead the platform modernisation project. While communication skills are evident, the absence of direct experience in the required tech stack and team leadership makes the candidate unsuitable for this role.
